# segzify golden fixtures

Each JSON file fixes one observable conversion result of the Python [seiji-seikana-converter](https://gitlab.com/ne_sachirou/llm-wiki/-/tree/4e633c1bb0c244d8b7119e858213e79ed073d1b6/.claude/skills/seiji-seikana-converter) reference implementation. Rust tests added with the converter must compare both `output` and `report`.
